# Axiom Civil

> Axiom Civil provides senior survey management, project engineering support, and on-premise survey data processing for heavy civil infrastructure — marine, transit, bridge, tunnel, and federal projects. It is led by Choice Sterling, a California Professional Land Surveyor (PLS) with 25+ years in heavy civil construction and a U.S. Marine Corps veteran. Axiom Civil is a practice of A4 Strategic Solutions LLC.

Project experience listed on the site was performed by the founder while employed by prime contractors (e.g., Kiewit, Skanska). Agencies named are not Axiom Civil clients or endorsers.
